name: <i>Aunt Judy’s Magazine</i>
title: <i>Aunt Judy’s Magazine</i>
---

This was a children’s magazine which ran 1866-1885.

It was edited by Margaret Gatty until 1873; from 1874-6 by her daughters Horatia Gatty and Juliana Ewing; from 1877-85 by Horatia Gatty.
